tool: grok
version: grok 0.2.103 (89c3d36fb6f1) [stable]
date: 2026-07-18
geometry: 120x40
command: grok --permission-mode default
note: "Run Grok Build in a project directory?" picker. Appears on EVERY
  session's first prompt submit in a directory grok has not been told to
  remember — i.e. after readiness and after the prompt was pasted. IsReady
  must reject it (no "│ ❯" input row) so a resumed/slow boot never pastes
  into it, but HandleStartup cannot answer it: it renders post-submit.
  Known automation hazard; grok queues the submitted prompt and continues
  once a human answers.
